text: [calm, natural narrator voice] One number keeps the score: the magnetic <|phoneme_start|>R EH1 N AH0 L D Z<|phoneme_end|> number, R-M. It is the flow's speed, times its size, divided by the magnetic diffusivity. Large R-M: stretching outpaces smudging. Small R-M: smudging wins.
